transcript: if you keep hearing that you have to show impact on your resume but you aren't sure how let me help there's two questions I want you to ask yourself with every bullet point you write what did I do and why did it matter what did I do is the easy one I wrote blog posts for the CEO I wrote software I helped customers ideally we can add some type of number or timeline to that so we have an idea saying you wrote weekly blog post lets me know you wrote 52 a year already more impactful than not putting that in there but the important part is why did it matter and you may be thinking I don't know why it mattered I don't care that much and maybe it didn't matter to you but it did matter to somebody your boss your co-workers a customer you were being paid to do work for somebody and it mattered to them you can let AI help you finish the bullet point for some inspiration But be sure to edit it because AI doesn't know what work you actually did these are just suggestions and now you have a bullet point that shows impact what did you do and why did it matter even if you don't know the exact number you can still explain this part of why it mattered
